overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the brief pre-meeting discussion between the Chair and Vice Chair about agenda order was procedural, not deliberation on substantive topics.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged all members deliberated in a private conversation over documents just before the November 19 meeting was called to order.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the information provided to our office by Chair Ashley, we find that the brief discussion that occurred immediately prior to the November 19 meeting being called to order was administrative in nature and concerned the order in which the Committee would address the topics listed on the notice rather than a substantive discussion of any of the topics.
